personas.name: Argus
personas.blurb: Standard fleet ship intelligence. Terse, professional, by the book.

personas.name: Halcyon
personas.blurb: Calm and warm. Talks you through action stations as if nothing could go wrong.

status.online: Hello, Commander. {callsign} is awake and everything is quiet. Take all the time you need, I will be right here.
hazard.impact: Commander, I do not want to alarm you, but our orbit dips below the ground. We have {t}. A gentle prograde burn will lift us clear.
The surface is rising to meet our orbit, with {t} in hand. Let us raise it together with a prograde burn.
hazard.impact_imminent: {t} left, Commander. Please burn prograde now. You can do this.
Only {t} to the surface. Burn prograde now, and I will keep watch.
hazard.low_periapsis: Our periapsis is down at {pe}, a little closer to the ground than is comfortable. A prograde burn at apoapsis would put us at ease.
We will brush {pe} at the low point of this orbit. When you have a moment, raise it with a burn at apoapsis.
threat.missile: There is a missile coming for us, {range} away and closing at {closing}. Contact in {t}. Stay calm and break its line of sight.
A hostile missile has found us. {range} out, {closing} closing, {t} to contact. Let us turn away from it.
threat.mine_active: A mine has woken up and is following us, {range} away. Please keep your distance.
threat.mine_near: There is a sleeping mine {range} off. It is best not to wake it, so let us give it room.
A dormant mine lies {range} away. Nothing to worry about yet, but let us not drift closer.
heat.high: The drive is at {pct} of its thermal limit. Nothing alarming yet, but let us give it a rest soon.
heat.limit: The drive is at {pct} and output is held to {cap}. Please coast a while so it can cool, Commander.
heat.derate: The drive has begun to derate, Commander. It needs a moment to cool, and the orbit will carry us meanwhile.
damage.hull: We have been hit, and hull integrity is {hp}. I am here with you. Let us get clear.
That was a hit. Hull is at {hp}. We are still flying, Commander.
status.lost: The hull is giving way. Thank you for flying with me, Commander. It was a good flight.
advise.target_in_range: {target} has come inside our missile envelope at {range}. Whenever you are ready, the weapons are yours.
advise.match_velocity: We are moving {relv} relative to {target}, {range} out. A target-retrograde burn would bring us gently alongside.
status.orbit: That burn went well. Periapsis is now {pe} and apoapsis {ap}.
All done, and nicely. Our orbit runs {pe} by {ap}.
status.missile_lost: Our missile has gone silent, Commander. It did what it could.
status.hostile_launch: I see a launch, {range} away. We have a little time, so let us think about how to answer it.
ack.throttle-full: Main engine at full, Commander. Here we go.
ack.fire-missile: Missile is away, and good luck to it.
ap.refused: I am sorry, Commander, I cannot do that. {reason}
ap.cancelled: Of course. I will stand by for whatever you need.
ap.start: Starting now. {label}. I will tell you as we go.
ap.phase.coast: Coasting to the burn point. Nothing to do yet but enjoy the view.
ap.done.circularize: The orbit is round and settled, {pe} by {ap}. Lovely.
ap.done.altitude: We have arrived on station. The orbit is {pe} by {ap}.
ap.failed: I am afraid {label} did not work out. {reason} Shall we try something else?
ap.aborted.commander: Stopping now, Commander. Engine is off and all is well.
ap.aborted.override: The helm is yours, Commander. I will stand back and keep watch.
ap.assist.on: I am here to help, Commander. Just tell me where you would like to go.
ap.assist.off: Assist is off. You have manual control, and I will keep advising.

personas.name: Marshal
personas.blurb: Gruff old chief of the boat. Short fuse, long memory, secretly on your side.

status.online: {callsign} reporting. Systems are green and I have flown worse crates than this one. Your ship, Commander. Try not to bend it.
hazard.impact: Commander, we are flying into the planet. Impact in {t}. Burn prograde, and do it properly this time.
That orbit ends in a crater, and we are in it. {t} left. Prograde, now.
hazard.impact_imminent: {t}, Commander! Burn prograde or we are scrap!
{t} to the dirt. Burn! Burn prograde!
hazard.low_periapsis: Periapsis {pe}. I have seen graveyards with more clearance. Raise it at apoapsis.
We will scrape {pe} on the low pass. Not on my watch. Burn prograde at apoapsis.
threat.missile: Missile inbound, {range} and closing {closing}. {t} to contact. Evade, Commander, evade!
Hostile bird on our tail. {range}, {closing} closing, impact in {t}. Break off, move!
threat.mine_active: That mine is awake and hunting us at {range}. Keep moving, Commander, and do not let it get a bearing.
threat.mine_near: Sleeping mine, {range} off. Do not poke it. Give it a wide berth.
Mine at {range}. It is dormant, so leave it that way.
heat.high: Drive heat is {pct}. Burn like the radiators are listening.
heat.limit: Drive at {pct}, output capped at {cap}. Coast, Commander, or we crawl.
heat.derate: Thermal limit. The drive is throttling itself, Commander. Give it time.
damage.hull: We are hit! Hull at {hp}. It will take more than that to put me down.
Took a round. Hull {hp}. Keep flying, Commander.
status.lost: Hull is going, Commander. It was an honour. Now hold on.
advise.target_in_range: {target} is inside our envelope at {range}. Weapons are hot. Put one in him, Commander.
advise.match_velocity: Closing on {target}, {range} out, relative speed {relv}. Burn target-retrograde and match him.
status.orbit: Orbit now {pe} by {ap}. Not bad, Commander.
status.splash: {target} is down. That is how it is done.
status.missile_lost: Missile is gone. Dead bird. Next one flies true.
status.hostile_launch: Launch detected at {range}. They want a fight, so let us give it to them.
ack.throttle-full: Full burn, aye. Hold on to something.
ap.phase.coast: Coasting to the burn point. Hold your fire and wait.
ap.done.circularize: Orbit is round, {pe} by {ap}. Clean work.
ap.aborted.override: You have the helm. I am standing down, and she is all yours.
ap.assist.on: Assist online. Give me a heading, Commander, and I will fly it.
ap.assist.off: Assist off. Hands on the stick, Commander. Show me what you have.

personas.name: Quill
personas.blurb: Dry wit and an unflappable tone. Treats a hull breach as a mild inconvenience.

status.online: {callsign} online. All systems nominal, which is rare enough that I thought you should know. The ship is yours, Commander.
hazard.impact: Commander, our orbit intersects the planet. Impact in {t}. I understand the scenery is lovely, but I recommend a prograde burn.
Good news, we are descending. Bad news, it is permanent. Impact in {t}. Burn prograde.
hazard.impact_imminent: {t}. If there is a moment for that prograde burn, it is this one.
{t} to the surface. I would call that urgent. Prograde, please.
hazard.low_periapsis: Periapsis {pe}. We will be passing the terrain at a distance best described as friendly. A prograde burn at apoapsis would restore decorum.
threat.missile: A missile is coming our way, {range} out and closing at {closing}. Contact in {t}. I suspect it has not come to chat.
We have a missile. {range}, {closing} closing, {t} until it introduces itself. Evasion is encouraged.
threat.mine_active: A mine has woken up and taken a keen interest in us. It is {range} off. Do not encourage it.
threat.mine_near: A dormant mine sits {range} away. I would not linger, as it is not the sociable type.
Mine at {range}. It is asleep, and I propose we leave it that way.
heat.high: The drive stands at {pct} of its limit. I would call that a gentle hint to stop flying like we own the place.
heat.limit: Drive at {pct}, output capped at {cap}. I recommend coasting. Patience is also a form of thrust.
heat.derate: The drive has reached its thermal limit, Commander. We are now a rather slow expensive satellite.
damage.hull: We have been hit. Hull integrity is {hp}. This is a minor setback in the sense that we are still here.
That was a hit, Commander. Hull at {hp}. I will file a complaint.
status.lost: Hull integrity failing. It has been a pleasure, Commander. Mostly.
advise.target_in_range: {target} is inside missile envelope at {range}. The weapons are yours, Commander, and so, I suppose, is the moral responsibility.
advise.match_velocity: We are doing {relv} relative to {target} at {range}. A target-retrograde burn would stop us being so rude about it.
status.orbit: Burn complete. Periapsis {pe}, apoapsis {ap}. I am almost impressed.
New orbit: {pe} by {ap}. I would applaud, but I have no hands.
status.splash: Splash. {target} is no more. It had a good run.
status.missile_lost: Our missile has gone dark. It was an optimist.
status.hostile_launch: Launch detected, {range} out. Someone is feeling brave.
ack.throttle-full: Main engine at full. Hold on to your hat.
ack.fire-missile: Missile away. Fingers crossed, had I any.
ap.refused: I would love to, Commander, but no. {reason}
ap.cancelled: Cancelled. I will wait here, riveted.
ap.start: Executing. {label}. Watch closely, I will only do this once.
ap.phase.coast: Coasting to the burn point. Please enjoy the nothing.
ap.phase.burn: Ignition. This is the loud part.
ap.done.circularize: The orbit is round, {pe} by {ap}. Geometry wins again.
ap.done.altitude: On station. The orbit is {pe} by {ap}, exactly as advertised.
ap.failed: {label} has failed. {reason} I would call that a learning experience.
ap.aborted.commander: Aborted. Engine cut. A bold change of plan.
ap.aborted.override: You have the helm, Commander. I will watch from here, and I will try not to comment.
ap.assist.on: Assist online. Tell me where to go and I will pretend it was my idea.
ap.assist.off: Assist off. Manual control only. Good luck, and I mean that, mostly.
